agi_admin_site_policy.title: AGI site policy
agi_admin_site_policy.description: Sites AGI may act on, and what it may do there. A blocklist entry always wins over any allow, including a site the person approved for themselves. While an allowlist entry exists, only listed sites are reachable. Each rule names an exact origin (https://example.com) or a host and its subdomains (https://*.example.com); the scheme and port must match. Omitting capabilities applies the rule to all of them. A document this schema rejects, or one AGI cannot read, stops AGI acting on every site until it is fixed.

version.title: Policy version
version.description: A positive integer. Raise it whenever the lists change.

blocklist.title: Blocked sites
blocklist.description: Rules that deny. Checked before anything that allows.

capabilities.title: What the rule covers
capabilities.description: Any of automation, upload, download. Omit to cover all three.

allowlist.title: Allowed sites
allowlist.description: Rules that permit, and, while any exist, the outer bound: a site outside them is unreachable however the person's own approved-sites list reads.

capabilities.title: What the rule covers
capabilities.description: Any of automation, upload, download. Omit to cover all three.
